Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer with expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and AI application development. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered solutions while leveraging modern cloud platforms, open-source frameworks, and Generative AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement advanced solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs)
Take ownership of end-to-end AI solution development and delivery
Conduct research and stay up to date with the latest advancements in Generative AI and LLM technologies
Develop and maintain reusable code libraries, tools, and frameworks for AI applications
Participate in code reviews and ensure high code quality standards
Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical roadmaps and integrate AI solutions into enterprise systems
Analyze complex business problems and develop AI-driven solutions
Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
Primary Skills Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Hands-on experience in:
Use case classification
Topic modeling
Question Answering (Q&A) and chatbots
Enterprise search
Document AI
Text summarization
Content generation

OR

Computer Vision & Audio
Hands-on experience in:
Image classification
Object detection
Image segmentation
Image generation
Audio and video analysis
Generative AI
Strong experience with SaaS-based LLM platforms and frameworks, including:
LangChain
LlamaIndex
Vector databases
Prompt Engineering (Chain of Thought, Tree of Thought, ReAct, AI Agents)
Azure OpenAI
Google Vertex AI
AWS Bedrock (text, audio, image, and video modalities)
Experience with open-source LLM ecosystems, including:
TensorFlow
PyTorch
Hugging Face
Quantization techniques
LLM fine-tuning using PEFT
Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
Data annotation workflows
GPU optimization and utilization
Cloud
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as:
Microsoft Azure
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Cloud certifications are preferred
Application Development
Strong proficiency in:
Python
Docker
FastAPI, Django, or Flask
Git
